title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・そして、烈風

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (…It hurts! I feel as if my lungs might collapse! The extra distance is brutal!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (I've never felt this before… The wind that always embraces me so kindly feels stifling like a veil of mud!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant… Ngh… Huff! Huff!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's voice…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (It's the tailwind at my back, pushing me on—the last gust I need to lift me up into the realm of the supreme!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: That wind… I must breathe it in!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (The wind about my body… Has it stopped?)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (My body feels so light that… I can keep running. I'm free… I'm free!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I see… Yes, that's it. It's not that the wind's stopped. It's that, right now…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I am the wind!

text_block_list.name: Zephyr Fans
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO! Go, Zephyrrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Is this really happening?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Is she really about to accomplish the unprecedented? Is she going to become a triple-distance champion?

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: …You can do it, Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Wind-Like Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Go. You are the true wind.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: And Yamanin Zephyr finishes first! It's Yamanin Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: She seized victory in a sprint! She seized victory in a mile! And now, she's won a medium-distance race!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: We have just witnessed something unprecedented! Not even the Mile Emperor herself could pull this off—triple-distance domination!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr has done it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Ah.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: How does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: How can I explain this feeling?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Heh, hehe, ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I can't even begin to put it into words!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her arms outstretched, Yamanin Zephyr runs toward me. She moves lightly, breezily, and most of all—freely.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A little flustered, I brace myself to catch her so she doesn't hurt herself, but… there's no heavy impact. She feels so incredibly light.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fierce, and free, and light… She really is the wind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Zephyr's feeling bold.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But wow, she actually did it. She went and won the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahhh…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I can't believe she surpassed her Emperor first! AGH!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Kyah?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Teio! You're supposed to be recuperating! Please don't suddenly raise your voice like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aha, my bad! I'm just kinda upset I didn't get to run. It's frustrating, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Like, it's kinda killing me. It really, really sucks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Teio…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: But I'm not just gonna sit back and take this! All right, back to rehab.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And… thanks, McQueen. For all your help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's quite all right, really.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: With all the injuries you've suffered, you've been forced to stay off the track for so long now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And yet you're adamant about pursuing a goal as reckless as the Arima Kinen… I couldn't leave you to your own devices if I wanted to.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you sure don't mince your words!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …But you're right. I don't wanna give up. I'm gonna make it happen, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: After all, Zephyr won.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: So I'm gonna win too. I'm gonna make a miraculous comeback and achieve something not even the Emperor could.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: When the Arima Kinen comes around, victory's gonna be mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …You're really quite something, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: All right, in that case, we have no time to waste. Are you ready to resume training?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yep! I've never been more ready! Let's do this, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's. Oh, and I'll be arranging for you to get your shot from the Mejiro family doctor later on.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Eep?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe… It's nothing. I simply sensed a breath of fresh air blowing once more.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I doubt I need to say this, but…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'm not yet satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: It's true that the sensation I felt during today's race was one I had longed for.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But perhaps, beyond that wind blows a stronger, fiercer wind—one that's freer still.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Which means…
choice_data_list: The still's a ways off yet. Right?
The still's a ways off yet. Right?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Right.
